Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades , Downgrades & Initiations 
$GOOGL, $AMZN, $AAPL, $BHP, $C 
Daily HeffX-LTN reviews Wall Street analysts research reports to find new investing and trading ideas for our readers. Some reports cover stocks to buy , and others cover stocks to sell or avoid. 
Below is a list of Wall Street’s Top analysts outlook for Key issues for Thursday, as follows: 
Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) analysts at Monnes Crespi Hardt is calling the parent of Google a buy with a 1,280 price target . 
Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) Monnes Crespi Hardt analysts calling Apple Buy and with a 2,000 price target . The consensus target price is at 1,670.65. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) was started as Buy with a 235 price target at Monnes Crespi Hardt. The st Its consensus target price is at 191.85. 
BHP Billiton Ltd. (NYSE:BHP) was raised to Buy from Hold at Deutsche Bank. 
Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) was raised to Buy from Hold and the price target was raised to 85 from 82 at HSBC.
